body: ## Problem `publish-worker.yaml`'s `publish` job is a per-platform matrix (`linux/amd64` -> `ubuntu-latest`, `linux/arm64` -> `ubuntu-24.04-arm`) where **each shard pushes the SAME tag** with `push: true`: ```yaml - name: Build and push (${{ matrix.platform }}) uses: docker/build-push-action@v7 with: platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }} push: true tags: ${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }} # ${base}:${ver}[,:latest], no per-arch suffix ``` Pushing the same tag from two shards (no `push-by-digest` + manifest merge) leaves a **last-shard-wins single-arch tag**: whichever shard finishes second overwrites the tag with its single architecture. A 2-platform publish therefore yields a single-arch image, not a multi-arch manifest list — so a consumer pulling the tag on the "losing" arch gets the wrong architecture (or a pull/exec failure). The workflow's own docstring claims "Each platform is published as a separate manifest entry inside the same image tag", which is **not** what the current steps do. ## How found Surfaced while implementing #587 (release-test-tools native-runner matrix). `release-test-tools.yaml` was fixed correctly there with **push-by-digest per shard + a `merge` job** (`docker buildx imagetools create`); `publish-worker.yaml` has the same native-matrix shape but the naive same-tag-per-shard push, so it carries this latent bug. ## Suggested fix Mirror the #587 release-test-tools pattern: each `publish` shard pushes by digest (`outputs: type=image,name=,push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true`, no tag) and emits its digest as an artifact; a `merge` job downloads the digests and runs `docker buildx imagetools create -t ... @sha256: @sha256:`. This is a candidate for the "CI native-runner convergence" umbrella (#587): a single shared multi-arch publish helper / pattern across `release-test-tools.yaml` + `publish-worker.yaml` (and the platform->runner mapping). ## Impact / severity Latent: only bites a repo that actually publishes a 2-platform image via `call-publish` and has an arm64 consumer. Single-platform (default `linux/amd64`) publishes are unaffected. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `publish-worker.yaml` produces a true multi-arch manifest list for multi-platform calls (verified: `docker buildx imagetools inspect ` shows both `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`). - [ ] Structural guard in the workflow's bats spec (push-by-digest + imagetools merge), mirroring `release_test_tools_yaml_spec.bats`.
title: publish-worker: multi-platform publish pushes the same tag per shard -> last-shard-wins single-arch (no manifest merge)
